Job Description Position: Software Engineer II, Frontend Base Location: New Delhi Location: India (Remote / Hybrid) Experience: 4+ years About Chegg Skills As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning." We build the applications and systems that help students make life-changing career transitions into high-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success. In this role, you will play a key role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed. Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth. About The Role We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student- and educator-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI-powered learning features. You will also contribute across the stack as needed — this is a frontend-first role with full-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it. What You'll Do Own frontend features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring — across our student and educator web applications. Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on. Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI — GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches — by tracing root cause across the stack. Build AI-powered learning features responsibly: validate model output before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry. Apply security and data-protection practices — input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of user data — as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for. Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work. Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation. Partner closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Content Operations to deliver and harden high-impact learner and educator workflows. Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews — including review of AI-generated code — reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low. Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed. Required Qualifications Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch. Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript. Working knowledge of web fundamentals — common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) — and the judgment to apply them without being told to. Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar). Strong testing and release-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce. Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically. Preferred Qualifications Experience with a CSS-in-JS styling approach and working alongside a component library (e.g., MUI). Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure — enough of a foundation to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when needed, even without prior production experience in those languages. Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application. Experience shipping AI-powered UI — streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos. Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar). Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another consumer-facing product company. Tech Stack Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) — enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, MSW Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI Observability: New Relic AI / ML: OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations) Why do we exist? Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can provide technical leadership while remaining hands-on in designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-based solutions. Provide technical direction for complex initiatives spanning multiple applications and engineering teams. Partner with Product, Business, and Engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Drive architecture/design and code reviews, evaluating trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, and reliability. Design and build backend services using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and distributed system patterns, with React/Node.js for end-to-end solutions where needed. Build reusable frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities that can be leveraged across teams. Drive engineering best practices around code quality, testing, security, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence. Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long-term solutions. Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. What You'll Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems. Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and distributed systems. Experience With React, TypeScript, Node.js And/or NestJS Is Preferred. Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, system design, and design patterns. Experience designing systems for scalability, high availability, resiliency, security, and performance. Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms such as Apache Airflow/Astronomer, including DAG development, scheduling, monitoring, and pipeline reliability. Experience building applications and APIs that integrate with large-scale enterprise data platforms. Working knowledge of Python and modern data processing technologies. Exposure to Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG, information retrieval, or machine learning. Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. At Harness, we're excited to welcome a Senior Engineer to the Coverage team, where you’ll play a central role in evolving the developer experience around code coverage and code quality. This is an opportunity to work on a high-impact product used by hundreds to thousands of engineering teams to ship higher-quality code, faster. As a Senior Engineer On The Coverage Team, You'll Take Ownership Of Critical Areas Of The Harness Code Coverage Product Suite, Including New and growing Coverage platform, which helps teams identify and prioritize coverage needs Report ingestion and processing which powers code coverage and quality insights Interactive dashboards that brings insights to life You’ll collaborate across product, design, and engineering teams to build seamless, performant, and intuitive user experiences. Whether you’re designing a new coverage feature or improving scalability and resilience in processing, you’ll be empowered to own the full stack and shape the future of how teams test and ship code. In this role you will Lead development across both frontend and backend systems of the Coverage product Own the architecture and implementation of key features in our coverage platform Improve developer workflows through integrations into other SCMs and CIs Author software functional specifications and design documents Champion performance, scalability, and reliability across the stack Partner closely with design, product, and other engineering teams to turn ideas into working software Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced and ever-evolving tech landscape, where your adaptability and problem-solving skills will be your greatest assets. Qualifications 4+ years of experience required. Previous contributions as part of a high-performing software engineering organization. Experience designing, extending, and maintaining high volume mission critical systems used by hundreds of thousands of end users. Experience with Go and PostgreSQL is preferred, but not required. Experience with React or similar is nice to have, but also not required. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
